run_extract_cluster_engine: run the ExtractClusterEngine to extract cluster assignments from a trained SSL model checkpoint
extract_clusters: extract cluster assignments for all dataset entries using the SelfSupervisionTrainer and save them to disk
register_extract_cluster_engine: register the extract_cluster engine with the vissl engine registry for CLI invocation
save_cluster_assignments: save cluster assignments and dataset representations to the output folder via ClusterAssignmentLoader
setup_extract_cluster_environment: setup distributed training environment, logging, seeds, and CUDA device before cluster extraction
